where_to_look: Input and freight costs: Q3 gross margin fell 190bp to 26.7% on inflation and management flagged Middle East-driven transportation and input-cost headwinds (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000074046/000162828026041544/odcf26q3ex991-earningsrele.htm) - natural gas (kiln fuel) and diesel/freight indices May-July 2026 are the measurable read-through
Retail cat litter channel: Walmart is Oil-Dri's largest customer - check Walmart/private-label litter commentary and scanner/category data for the quarter
Ag/Amlan animal-health and fluids purification (renewable diesel bleaching clay) segment - renewable diesel production volumes and Amlan international sales are the swing lines
Capital return: dividend increases historically announced around the Q4 print; check for an 8-K/dividend declaration in the window
No option market and 2 estimates, so the bar is thin - the company's own 'achieve annual plan and surpass last year's net income' statement in the Q3 release is the effective bar
